R_definition: Original recorded evaluation repetition field. Paper nonfinite fits retain planned R36 but produced no PF draws; raw_repetitions gives actual final evaluation draw count. Historical superseded scores are preserved in their original archives and are not counted here.

PyDPF.timing_scope: Actual unique batch times, not per-row multiplied times. All three use one A40 on different nodes. Fixed iteration configurations are not equal-time budgets. IFAD includes its complete IF2 prefix and failed attempt.

ADPF.fitting_scope: Unique whole-batch fitting wall time, including failure attempts; synchronized subset retained separately

raw_timing.accounting_note: Unique batch cost once. Saved score process wall already includes preparation/compilation/execution. Failed calls remain charged; residual allocation is not pure score time.

ADPF.missing_timing_note: No isolated fitting compile timer is reported. Score process wall contains its preparation/compile/execution; do not add nested fields.

IF2.fitting_scope: Unique whole-batch fitting wall time, including failure attempts; synchronized subset retained separately

raw_timing.accounting_note: 12 rows ran in one batch; batch fitting time is charged once, not 12 times. Scoring process wall already includes its preparation/compilation/execution. Allocation residual includes process imports, modules, environment checks, hashing and I/O; it is not pure scoring time.

IF2.missing_timing_note: No isolated fitting compile timer is reported. Score process wall contains its preparation/compile/execution; do not add nested fields.

IFAD.fitting_scope: Unique whole-batch fitting wall time, including failure attempts; synchronized subset retained separately

raw_timing.accounting_note: 12 rows start together; 11 continue after the row11 failure. Count unique batch fitting once, including full IF2 prefix and the failed attempt. Never multiply batch cost by12. Score process wall includes preparation/compilation/execution; residual allocation includes imports/checks/I/O.

IFAD.missing_timing_note: No isolated fitting compile timer is reported. Score process wall contains its preparation/compile/execution; do not add nested fields.

PyDPF.prior_cost_note: Prior cost is included only when separately recorded; None is unavailable, not zero. Formal allocation is not an all-project compute total.

TFP.timing_scope: Each synchronized call updates the whole batch of12 filters at T600/J5000. IF2=1950 passes, IFAD=175IF2+400Adam, native ADPF=425Adam from raw starts. Different fixed iteration counts, not equal wall time. Slurm occupation includes probe, graph preparation, imports, control PF, fitting, IO, final PF scoring and process overhead. Nested timing scopes must not be added twice. No prefix is physically shared between the IF2 arm and the IFAD arm.

ADPF.fitting_scope: Synchronized whole batch of12; excludes separate preparation/control/scoring/I/O
ADPF.missing_timing_note: Pure fitting compile time is not separable from first discarded execution; detailed graph-build/first-call times are retained in raw_timing.

IF2.fitting_scope: Synchronized whole batch of12; excludes separate preparation/control/scoring/I/O
IF2.missing_timing_note: Pure fitting compile time is not separable from first discarded execution; detailed graph-build/first-call times are retained in raw_timing.

IFAD.fitting_scope: Synchronized whole batch of12; excludes separate preparation/control/scoring/I/O
IFAD.missing_timing_note: Pure fitting compile time is not separable from first discarded execution; detailed graph-build/first-call times are retained in raw_timing.

TFP.prior_cost_note: Prior cost is included only when separately recorded; None is unavailable, not zero. Formal allocation is not an all-project compute total.

Dynamax.timing_scope: Each trial is scalar B1 on one A40, three methods sequentially; method totals sum12 separate trials. Native SGD fit includes internal compilation. IF2 explicit preparation and independent scoring are separate. Failed early fits retain actual shorter cost; not a successful-fit speedup. Not a12-filter batched kernel timing.

IF2.fitting_scope: Sum of12 separate scalar fits; native SGD internal compilation stays inside fitting
IF2.missing_timing_note: Three methods share each task allocation. Per-method allocation and whole scoring-process time are not separately measured; internal SGD compile time is not isolated.

IFAD_097.fitting_scope: Sum of12 separate scalar fits; native SGD internal compilation stays inside fitting
IFAD_097.missing_timing_note: Three methods share each task allocation. Per-method allocation and whole scoring-process time are not separately measured; internal SGD compile time is not isolated.

SGD_alpha1.fitting_scope: Sum of12 separate scalar fits; native SGD internal compilation stays inside fitting
SGD_alpha1.missing_timing_note: Three methods share each task allocation. Per-method allocation and whole scoring-process time are not separately measured; internal SGD compile time is not isolated.

Dynamax.prior_cost_note: Prior cost is included only when separately recorded; None is unavailable, not zero. Formal allocation is not an all-project compute total.

IF2.fitting_scope: Unique whole batch of12; includes full IFAD prefix
IF2.missing_timing_note: Repair compilation is recorded once for all methods, not allocated per method. Whole scoring-process time and per-method allocation are not isolated.

IFAD.fitting_scope: Unique whole batch of12; includes full IFAD prefix
IFAD.missing_timing_note: Repair compilation is recorded once for all methods, not allocated per method. Whole scoring-process time and per-method allocation are not isolated.

ADPF_extension.fitting_scope: Unique whole batch of12; includes full IFAD prefix
ADPF_extension.missing_timing_note: Repair compilation is recorded once for all methods, not allocated per method. Whole scoring-process time and per-method allocation are not isolated.

PFJAX.timing_scope: Original fit and score job plus mandatory independent rescoring of all36 unchanged endpoints; old score costs retained. Method fit times are not multiplied by12.

PF + external Nelder-Mead.fitting_scope: 12 scalar single-core CPU fits summed, including late rejected calls
PF + external Nelder-Mead.missing_timing_note: No isolated fitting compile timer; reported scoring process wall includes its preparation, compilation and execution.

pypfilt.timing_scope: 12 scalar CPU fits,1800s each; final late calls and independent scoring charged. Not a GPU speed comparison.

PF + external Nelder-Mead.fitting_scope: 12 scalar single-core CPU fits summed, including late rejected calls
PF + external Nelder-Mead.missing_timing_note: No isolated fitting compile timer; reported scoring process wall includes its preparation, compilation and execution.

particles.timing_scope: 12 scalar CPU fits,1800s each; final late calls and independent scoring charged. Not a GPU speed comparison.

Paper two-package comparison.timing_scope: Final PF scoring was not separately timed. Residual allocation includes evaluation compilation/execution, startup, cache cleanup, I/O, hashing and other overhead. It is not a PF-only runtime.

PFJAX.native: PFJAX模型/接口作为接入基础
PFJAX.evaluated: IF2、IFAD和直接ADPF三主组均为本地扩展
PFJAX.limitation: 原生OT重采样没有通过完整Dacca梯度门槛，不包含在本次三组结果中；不能把本地ADPF称为PFJAX原生OT结果。

PyDPF.evaluated: IF2扰动/冷却和alpha=.97折扣接入为本地扩展，底层PF与重采样使用PyDPF
PyDPF.limitation: 直接ADPF从原始起点开始，IFAD含175次IF2；差异不能单独归因于alpha。

TFP.native: 直接alpha1使用原生particle_filter的unbiased_gradients=True与原生Keras Adam
TFP.evaluated: IF2参数扰动和alpha=.97梯度折扣为本地扩展；PF/SMC及systematic重采样接口来自TFP
TFP.limitation: 每步重采样为明确配置，不是默认ESS自适应选项；梯度XLA失败后采用普通TF GPU图，未换成别包实现。

Dynamax.evaluated: 接入本地Dacca粒子滤波、IF2和IFAD扩展
Dynamax.limitation: 不是Dynamax原生通用PF或EM比较；正式结果使用独立标量调用，非12-filter批量核。

pypfilt.limitation: 这是CPU预算实验，不是原生梯度优化器或EM结果。

particles.limitation: 这是CPU预算实验，不是原生梯度优化器或EM结果。

Paper/Cuthbert.evaluated: 本地IF2/DMOP/IFAD扩展；论文比较训练循环复用PyPOMP Adam
Paper/Cuthbert.limitation: 这些扩展并非Cuthbert开箱即有的参数估计设施，也不是其EM基线。

Paper/PyPOMP.evaluated: 论文固定迭代和冷却/学习率设置下的IF2与IFAD
Paper/PyPOMP.limitation: 100起点论文实验与新增包6起点×2重复实验分别统计。

scope_notes: All use original600-month Gaussian Dacca and20 Euler steps per month,J5000,23 free coordinates.
Paper100-start and added6-start x2-replicate experiments are distinct; oldJ1024 results are excluded.

All-finite medians retain poor, failed-fit, floor-saturated and imprecise endpoints. Conditional medians require a completed fit and no evaluation failure, without additionally dropping low-precision or floor points.
Fixed-iteration configurations do not establish equal-cost superiority or isolate alpha.
CPU and GPU costs are not pooled into a speed ranking; batch times are not multiplied by starts.
Separate per-package reproduction archives contain frozen sources, data, raw logs, raw scores, provenance and visual reviews.
